snippet.title: Hedgehog Creek - Online Web Browser World
snippet.description:
Play mini games, collect items and explore a virtual world from inside your web browser. This game will also work on some mobile smartphone web browsers.

Create your Hedgehog: ► https://www.hedgehogcreek.com/register

Currently this game is a test in its experimental stages. I created this concept game during lockdown while improving my web development and game development skills and also to bring a little cheer to the world where many people are stuck at home during lockdown. Inspired by online flash games I used to play as a kid.
